ReadAll: from text to pixels

This is an original rendering fixture for the ReadAll project.
The page uses actual TrueType advances, not estimated character cells.
Wide letters: WWWW MMMM. Narrow letters: iiii llll.
Curves and counters: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789.
Composite outlines: café, naïve, déjà vu. Greek: Ω α β.

A page is a view of the document, not the identity of its content.
Change the font size or page width and restore the saved text locator.
The renderer should find the same passage under the new layout.

Rasterization is implemented in Rust using quadratic outlines.
This first renderer does not perform shaping, kerning, or word breaking.
It is an engineering step toward a native reader, not a finished GUI.
